_comment: Notion database structure for Notion Affiliate Agent — 3 tables. This file is the source of truth for creating the databases via Notion API. No database has been created yet — Founder must provide NOTION_API_KEY and run the creation script.

databases.title: Notion Product Tracker
databases.description: Tracks Notion-related products, features, and affiliate links via Cuelinks

Name.description: Product name (e.g., Notion AI, Notion Calendar)

Affiliate Link.description: Cuelinks affiliate link (empty until Cuelinks approval)

Cons.description: Genuine cons/drawbacks (at least 2) — required, no review without drawbacks

databases.title: Notion Content Calendar
databases.description: Content calendar for Notion affiliate content — all entries are DRAFT until Founder approval

Review Notes.description: Review notes, including NEEDS FOUNDER PERSONAL INPUT flags

Disclosure.description: Always: This content contains affiliate links

databases.title: Notion Performance Tracker
databases.description: Tracks performance of published content — populated only after Founder manually publishes and Cuelinks provides data

Clicks.description: Clicks via Cuelinks (from Cuelinks dashboard, manually entered)

creation_notes.notion_api_required: NOTION_API_KEY must be set in .env (never committed) — Founder must create an internal integration at https://www.notion.so/my-integrations and share the databases with it
creation_notes.creation_script: notion_affiliate_agent/create_databases.py — run after NOTION_API_KEY is set (not yet, per directive)
creation_notes.local_fallback: For local development without Notion, use notion_affiliate_agent/local_store.json (JSON file, same schema, no API needed)
creation_notes.status: STRUCTURE DEFINED — NOT YET CREATED IN NOTION (awaiting Founder NOTION_API_KEY)
